paragraphs: Fermi Inc.'s stock price is 6.4, with a change of -3.03% compared to the prior close and 2.4% over a window of 23 sessions. The price is as of August 14, 2026.

There are 3 new news headlines in the last 24 hours, including reports from Kalkine Media and Bloomberg about Fermi Inc. submitting its Q2 2026 SEC 10-Q report and receiving a US subpoena tied to Project Matador. The subpoena is for certain documents related to the project, a massive data center campus being developed in west Texas.

Fermi Inc. has 25 total filings in its feed, including 1 Form 4 filing and 12 proxy solicitation filings. Recent filings include a 10-Q report, a SCHEDULE 13G/A filing, and several 8-K filings, one of which announces the appointment of Lee McIntire as the company's new Chief Executive Officer, effective August 11, 2026.
